definitions.explanation: Being alike or of the same kind. Used to indicate similarity between things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同様|どうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧でした。
examples.english: The result was the same as last year.

examples.japanese: {同様|どうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えています→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
これ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{同様|どうよう}です。

notes:
{同様|どうよう} is a formal way to express sameness or similarity. More common in written Japanese and formal speech than in casual conversation.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {同様|どうよう}に (similarly, likewise)
- Noun modifier: {同様|どうよう}の/な + noun
- Predicate: {同様|どうよう}だ/です (is the same)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xと{同様|どうよう}に: the same as X
- {同様|どうよう}の{理由|りゆう}: the same reason
- ～と{同様|どうよう}: just like ~
- AはBと{同様|どうよう}である: A is the same as B (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同|おな}じ: same (casual, everyday)
- {同様|どうよう}: same (formal, written)
- {類似|るいじ}: similarity (technical, emphasizes resemblance)
- {同一|どういつ}: identical (strict identity, not just similarity)

HOMOPHONE:
Do not confuse with {動揺|どうよう} (agitation, being shaken).
